name: Koiya International Limited
about: Koiya International Limited provides baby care products in India. The company offers various products including clothing for newborns and infants, fabric wash, baby wipes, shampoo, body wash, soap, diapers, toys and accessories, etc. It sells its products online. The company was formerly known as Popees Cares Limited and changed its name to Koiya International Limited in March 2026. Koiya International Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Chennai, India.
